name: Sherlock Shellingford
original_name: シャーロック・シェリンフォード
source:
A member of "Milky Holmes".

The airheaded leader of Milky Holmes. She's known to be particularly clumsy but is always caring. Her Toys give her the power of telekinesis.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tantei_Opera_Milky_Holmes#Milky_Holmes]Wikipedia[/url]]
